sbh4.2:2.1: Printed text (Shukla pp. 449–451) restored where the transcription dropped 2.1–2.11.
sbh4.2:2.2: Printed *kāmavitarko*, so the MS; read *kāmaviveko* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 180).
sbh4.2:2.6: Printed *avitarkavicāreṣv*, so the MS; read *vitarkavicāreṣv* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 183).
sbh4.2:2.7: Printed *kāmavivekaṁ(kaḥ) tasyānantaramutpannaṁ(nnaḥ)*; read *kāmavivekaḥ tasyānantaram utpannaṁ*, the MS neuter, without Shukla's bracketed *utpannaḥ* (Deleanu 2006, nn. 188–189).
sbh4.2:2.8: Printed *taddhetukaṁ(kas) tatpratyayaṁ(yas)*; read *taddhetukaṁ tatpratyayaṁ*, without Shukla's bracketed forms (MS per Deleanu 2006, nn. 190–191). Printed *vādoṣadarśanāt*, so the MS, i.e. *vā adoṣa-*; Deleanu 2006 reads *cādoṣa-* (n. 194).
sbh4.2:2.11: Printed *akisara(akṛtsna?)lābhī*; read *akisaralābhī*, without Shukla's bracketed query (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 199).
sbh4.2:3.1: Printed *savitarkasavicāraviviktebhyaḥ*; read *savitarkasavicārasamādhinimittebhyaḥ* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 202). Printed *vyāvartayitvā(ttaṁ vyāvartya)*; read *vyāvartayitvā* (n. 203).
sbh4.2:3.4: Printed *ekadharmatayā*; read *ekarasatayā* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 205). Printed *pravartate* (the MS has *pravarttata*) is kept; Deleanu 2006 reads *pravartayati* with Tibetan (n. 206).
sbh4.2:3.6: Printed *vitarkavicārasya samādheḥ, sacchidrasāntarām*; read *vitarkavicārasacchidrasāntarām* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 209).
sbh4.2:3.8: Printed *vā doṣadarśanāt*; read *cādoṣadarśanāt* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 217).
sbh4.2:3.9: Printed *daurmanasyagataṁ*, so the MS; read *saumanasyagataṁ* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 219). Printed *suravānugatvāt*; read *sukhānugatvāt* (Deleanu 2006, ed. p. 332).
sbh4.2:4.14: Printed text and the MS lack *na* before *samudācaranti*; supplied after Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 231).
sbh4.2:5.1: Printed text omits *bhāvanānvayād*; supplied from the MS (per Deleanu 2006, n. 239).
sbh4.2:5.3: Printed text omits *tenāha sukhaṁ ca kāyena pratisaṁvedayate*; supplied from the MS (per Deleanu 2006, n. 247).
sbh4.2:5.9: Printed text omits *upekṣakaḥ*; supplied from the MS (per Deleanu 2006, n. 249). Printed *vṛddhāś ca vṛddhaśrāvakāś ca*; read *buddhāś ca buddhaśrāvakāś ca* (MS per Deleanu 2006, nn. 252–253).
sbh4.2:6.1: Printed *tatrātulyajātīyatvāt*, so the MS; read *tatra tulyajātīyatvāt* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 255).
sbh4.2:6.7: Printed text repeats *pūrvam eva ca … caturthadhyānasamāpattikāle* (6.7–6.8) from 6.11–6.12, so the MS; a dittography, not rendered (Deleanu 2006, n. 260).
sbh4.2:6.12: Printed *tanna*; read *tatra* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 264). Printed *na viśiṣṭā*, so the MS; read *avaśiṣṭā* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 268).
sbh4.2:6.19: Printed *yathāpramāṇādiṣu sthāneṣu*; read *yathā prathamādiṣu dhyāneṣu* (Deleanu 2006, n. 275).
sbh4.2:7.1: Printed *pratisaṁyuktatāmasātāmasātayā nirvirāgatayā*, so the MS, corrupt; the sense follows Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, nn. 278–279, reading *anābhāsagatayā nirvidvirāgatayā*).
sbh4.2:7.2: Printed text omits *samatikraman nāsau* after the lemma; supplied from the MS (per Deleanu 2006, n. 280; he reads *tāsāṁ samatikramād*). Printed *sā (yā) sā*; read *sā* (n. 282).
sbh4.2:7.3: Printed text omits *yāna*; supplied from the MS (per Deleanu 2006, n. 287).
sbh4.2:7.6: Printed *bhāvayitvā*, so the MS; read *vibhāvayitvā* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 290).
sbh4.2:7.7: Printed *ākāśama(śaṁsa) sāmantakam*; read *ākāśam | sa sāmantakam* (Deleanu 2006, n. 292). Printed *ucca-*; read *ūrdhvaṁ* (MS per Deleanu 2006, nn. 294–295).
sbh4.2:8.3: Printed *samayena*, so the MS; read *sa yena* with Tibetan (Deleanu 2006, n. 297).
sbh4.2:10.1: Printed *tenāha saṁjñī yaduta*, so the MS; a dittography of 10.4, not rendered (Deleanu 2006, n. 315).
sbh4.2:10.3: Printed *[a]kiñcanasaṁjñā*; read *kiñcanasaṁjñā*, without Shukla's bracketed *a-* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 318).
sbh4.2:10.4: Printed *saṁjñī yaduta kiñcanasaṁjñāyā vā, akiñcanasaṁjñāyā vā, akiñcanasaṁjñā vā*, so the MS, corrupt; the sense follows Tibetan (Deleanu 2006, n. 320, reading *naivasaṁjñā yaduta kiñcanasaṁjñā vā akiñcanasaṁjñā vā*).
sbh4.2:10.5: Printed *nimittālambane*; read *'nimittālambane*, the same akṣaras, with Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 324).
sbh4.2:10.7: Printed *-sāmantakasya*; read *-sāmantakaṁ ca* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 327).
sbh4.2:10.9: Printed text (Shukla p. 458) restored where the transcription dropped 10.9–10.12.
sbh4.2:10.11: Printed *ākāśāt patanavat*, so the MS; read *ākāśotpatanavat* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 330).
sbh4.2:12.5: Printed *saṁjñāśalyaḥ (maṁ)*; read *saṁjñāśalyaḥ*, without Shukla's bracketed syllable (Deleanu 2006, n. 337).
sbh4.2:12.6: Printed *°otpannotpannām asaṁjñāsmṛtyamanasikārānu(ramanu)careti(rati)*; read *°otpannotpannāsu saṁjñāsv asmṛtyamanasikāram anucarati* (MS per Deleanu 2006, nn. 339–340; *-m anucarati* is his emendation of MS *°ānucareti*).
sbh4.2:12.9: Printed *śubhakṛtya-*; read *śubhakṛtsna-* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 344). Printed *bṛhatphalebhyo vītarāgasya*; read *bṛhatphalebhyo 'vītarāgasya*, the same akṣaras, with Tibetan, Xuanzang and the Abhidharmasamuccaya (10, 20; Deleanu 2006, n. 345).
sbh4.2:14.7: Printed *avadāta-*; read *avabhāsa-* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 366; cf. 15.45).
sbh4.2:14.8: Printed *amibhvāyatana-*; read *abhibhvāyatana-* (Deleanu 2006, n. 368). Printed *adhimokṣa-*, so the MS; read *vimokṣa-* with 15.68, Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 367).
sbh4.2:15.4: Printed text and the MS omit *pīṭhe* after *mañcāt*; supplied after Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 374).
sbh4.2:15.5: Printed text and the MS omit *tṛṇasaṁstarake* after *mañcāt*; supplied after Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 375).
sbh4.2:15.8: Printed *kauśayaṁ, kaccaṁ, padgaṁ*; read *kauśeyaṁ, kacaṁ, paṭṭaṁ* (MS per Deleanu 2006, nn. 377–379).
sbh4.2:15.21: Printed text omits *tiraḥśailaṁ*; supplied from the MS (per Deleanu 2006, n. 399).
sbh4.2:15.22: Printed text repeats 15.21 (*yena gacchati* for *kāyena gacchati*; Deleanu 2006, n. 400).
sbh4.2:15.33: Printed *yathaivādhimuktyā vā … cartukāmatā bhūtānāṁ*; read *yatheṣṭyādhimuktyā ca … caturṇāṁ mahābhūtānāṁ* (MS per Deleanu 2006, nn. 412–415).
sbh4.2:15.36: Printed *yatrāyaṁ*, restored where the transcription had *yatrārya*. Printed *audārāudārikaudārikatayā anuparivāṭikayā avyutkramanti(nte) kayā*; read *audārikaudārikatayānuparipāṭikayā avyutkramaṇikayā* (Deleanu 2006, n. 417; MS *audār-* is a dittography).
sbh4.2:15.41: Printed *vārayati*, so the MS; read *dhārayati* with Tibetan (Deleanu 2006, n. 425).
sbh4.2:15.46: Printed text omits *sattvavaicitryāc ca … manasi karoti*; supplied from the MS (per Deleanu 2006, n. 431).
sbh4.2:15.51: Printed *prayukta*, omitting *māyāśāṭhya*; read *mrakṣa* and *māyāśāṭhya* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 436).
sbh4.2:15.55: Printed text omits *unnatendriyatā*; supplied from the MS (per Deleanu 2006, n. 440).
sbh4.2:15.62: Printed *prākṛtā'prākṛtā vā*; the MS has *prākṛtāprākṛtā*, a dittography; read *prākṛta-* with Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 444).
sbh4.2:16.3: Printed *nimittaṁ*; read *nirmitaṁ* (MS per Deleanu 2006, n. 453). Printed text and the MS lack *yad yad evādhimucyate*; supplied after Tibetan and Xuanzang (Deleanu 2006, n. 454).
sbh4.2:16.7: Printed *na punar na*, so the MS; read *punar na* (Deleanu 2006, n. 457).
